common.scopeAssigned: You see the leads, opportunities and visits assigned to you in your projects. A sales manager sees the whole project (proposed decision E-05, not yet approved).
common.truth: Demo data, fictional. A stage records where the sales conversation is: moving an opportunity never creates a quotation, hold, reservation, booking or payment.

pipeline.title: Sales pipeline
pipeline.intro: Qualified leads become opportunities. Follow each one from the first site visit to a hold or reservation.
pipeline.boardLabel: Opportunity board, one column per stage
pipeline.dragHint: Drag a card to another stage, or use its Move menu.
pipeline.wonPlanned: Marking an opportunity won needs its booking, which arrives with bookings (Gate E.5). Nothing is marked won before then.
pipeline.stale: This opportunity was changed by someone else. The latest version is shown; nothing was moved.
pipeline.emptyBody: Change the search or filters, or convert a qualified lead.

convert.title: Convert a qualified lead
convert.intro: Opens one opportunity for the lead at the Qualified stage. The lead stays qualified; nothing is booked.
convert.leadDescription: Only qualified leads without an opportunity that you may see are listed.
convert.none: No qualified lead is waiting to be converted.
convert.presetUnavailable: That lead cannot be converted now: it is not qualified, already has an opportunity, or is not one of yours.

lost.title: Mark {{name}} as lost
lost.intro: The opportunity leaves the open stages. It can be reopened later.
lost.noteHint: Needed when the reason is Other.

reopen.title: Reopen {{name}}
reopen.intro: The opportunity returns to the stage it was lost from.

opportunity.chooseBody: Open one from the opportunities board or list.
opportunity.matchedUnits: Units that match the budget (on the lead)
opportunity.unitsShownEmpty: No unit recorded as shown yet.

event.converted: Opened the opportunity from the qualified lead
event.visitRescheduled: Moved the site visit from {{from}} to {{to}}

assign.title: Lead assignment
assign.subtitle: Give leads to a colleague who covers their project
assign.readOnly: You see your own leads and their history. Assigning leads needs a sales manager.
assign.historyEmpty: Not reassigned in this demo yet.
assign.selectFirst: Select one or more leads first.
assign.assigneeHint: Only colleagues who cover every selected lead's project are listed.
assign.reasonHint: At least 3 characters. Kept in the lead's history.
assign.presetMissing: That lead is not one you can see.

calendar.title: Site visits
calendar.intro: Every site visit by day. The agenda lists the same visits with the same actions.
calendar.agendaOnPhones: On a narrow screen the visits are shown as an agenda.
calendar.empty: No site visits match in this month.

visit.chooseBody: Open one from the site visits calendar.
visit.title: Site visit: {{name}}
visit.outcomePending: Not recorded yet. Record the outcome after the visit.
visit.outcomeBeforeDemo: The status was recorded before this demo; no feedback was captured.
visit.historyEmpty: No change recorded in this demo yet.
visit.rescheduleIntro: Now {{when}}. Choose a new half-hour slot; the customer will need to confirm again.
visit.slotRequired: Choose a date and a time.
visit.addUnitHint: Units of this project; up to 10.
visit.followUpHint: Within 60 days. Shows on the lead and Sales home.
visit.followUpBoth: Choose both a date and a time, or neither.

problems.stale_version: This record was changed meanwhile. Nothing was saved; the latest version is shown.
problems.booking_required: An opportunity is won only with a booking, which arrives in Gate E.5.
problems.not_lost: Only a lost opportunity can be reopened.
problems.already_converted: This lead already has an opportunity.
problems.not_qualified: Only a qualified lead can be converted.
problems.idempotency_key_reused: This request was already used for something else. Nothing was changed; try again.
problems.training_not_supported: The sales pipeline cannot be practised in practice mode.
problems.visit_not_pending: This visit is no longer scheduled.

errors.sameStage: The opportunity is already at this stage.
errors.useLost: Use “Mark as lost” and give a reason.
errors.closeOutOfRange: Choose today or a date within two years.
errors.assigneeUnavailable: This person cannot be given these leads.
errors.alreadyAssigned: {{name}} already owns at least one of these leads.
errors.timeInvalid: Enter a valid date and time.
errors.timeInPast: Choose a time later than now.
errors.timeOutsideHours: Choose a half-hour slot between 09:00 and 19:00.
errors.sameTime: The visit is already at this time.
errors.notYetHappened: This visit has not happened yet: it can only be cancelled.
errors.interestInvalid: Interest is recorded only for a completed visit.
errors.cancelReasonRequired: Say why it was cancelled (at least 3 characters).
errors.unitsOnlyCompleted: Units shown are recorded only for a completed visit.
errors.unitUnavailable: One of these units cannot be recorded for this visit.
